global.title: Auto start/stop defaults
global.description: Shared detection parameters for every eligible thermostat. Enable and stop mode initialize entities without saved states only; later default edits do not reset existing entities.

thermostat.title: Thermostat
thermostat.description: Select a thermostat needing different detection parameters. Enable and stop mode are remembered by its switch and select, without a dedicated configuration.

thermostat_options.title: Thermostat settings
thermostat_options.description: Detection parameters override global values for this thermostat without changing its saved enable state or stop mode.

error.not_over_climate: This thermostat is not an over_climate thermostat, so the auto start/stop cannot be applied to it.
error.valve_regulation: This thermostat is regulated by a valve, which the auto start/stop feature does not support.
error.invalid_entity: The selected thermostat no longer exists.

abort.already_configured: This thermostat already has an auto start/stop configuration.

init.title: Auto start/stop settings
init.description: Dedicated detection parameters override global values. Enable and stop-mode defaults, when shown, initialize new entities only and never reset saved states.

entity_id_conflict.message: Cannot reuse {entity_id}: it is already owned by another entity. Resolve the conflict and reload this configuration.

missing_configuration.message: The auto start/stop configuration no longer exists.
